summary: Concurrently dispatched workers share one scratchpad directory (keyed by the stoker session, not the dispatch), so parallel briefs can clobber each other's files

resolution.reason: the shared scratchpad is a harness-level property of this stoker session, not something heater's own code assigns or can fix; mitigation going forward is procedural, not code: future dispatch briefs will tell each worker to make and use its own named subdirectory under the scratchpad rather than writing at its root
